# Plumeria & Waikiki Banyan Vacation Rentals
> Boutique High-Floor 1-Bedroom Vacation Rental Suites at Waikiki Banyan Tower 2 (Honolulu, Hawaiʻi). Full kitchen, 1-acre resort recreation deck, free covered garage parking ($0/day), zero mandatory resort fees ($0/day), and 1 flat block to Kuhio Beach. Authorized Short-Term Rental (STR) license by the City and County of Honolulu. Direct booking with best rate guarantee and Korean concierge support.

## Core Properties
- Suite #3205-T2: 32nd-Floor Diamond Head and Emerald Koʻolau Mountain View Suite. Full kitchen, private lanai, high-speed Wi-Fi, air conditioning, Tommy Bahama beach gear, smart lock.
- Suite #3609-T2: 36th-Floor Penthouse Tier Panoramic Pacific Ocean and Sunset View Suite.
